scenes.text: A class records 3 paper strips. Which number should go in its measurement table? Let us think carefully. Count the same repeated units: 3. The answer is 3. Great work!
A class records 4 handspans. Which number should go in its measurement table? Let us think carefully. Count the same repeated units: 4. The answer is 4. Great work!
A class records 5 equal cupfuls. Which number should go in its measurement table? Let us think carefully. Count the same repeated units: 5. The answer is 5. Great work!
A class records 6 equal blocks. Which number should go in its measurement table? Let us think carefully. Count the same repeated units: 6. The answer is 6. Great work!
